propositions: Read-only derivations from git history and working tree compute four code-health metrics: module-size distribution, cap-change events, short-term churn, and refactor-to-addition ratio against a single flat hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt.
module_size_distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts at a ref against the single-sourced cap, returning count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc.
cap_change_events and churn are derived from git log; cap_change_events returns a list of old_limit/new_limit dicts (possibly empty); churn returns insertions and deletions summed from --numstat.
refactor_to_addition_ratio computes deletions/insertions from git log --numstat, returning None when total insertions is zero to avoid division by zero.

Four MetricSpec instances (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio) are registered in REGISTRY with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high, and context-adapter computes that pull repo_root/since/until from evaluation context.
